Chain tag is ambiguous (Gamers building, Animate-group brand).

Closed 31 Aug 2024 after about 20 years. Would in any case have been borderline for the product, since part of its range was adult PC-game related. Source: https://akiba-pc.watch.impress.co.jp/docs/news/news/1609135.html

closed_found.name_ja: イゼルローンフォートレス
closed_found.note: Legend of the Galactic Heroes themed dining cafe at 台東区上野2-1-9 GAOH黒門ビル2F, 76 m from 上野御徒町 station. A 【ダイニングカフェ・イゼルローンフォートレス】閉店のお知らせ notice was published and the online store closed 31 Dec 2025; the exact last day of the cafe itself is not stated in the sources I could read. It had 銀河帝国エリア and 同盟エリア seating. Also sat at the far north edge of the box, past where the Akihabara district really ends, so it was a scope call as well.
